app.title: NETRA-AI Eye Screening
capture.prompt.position: Position camera 5 cm from the eye, centred on the pupil
capture.intro: Enter patient details, then capture both eyes.
capture.both_eyes.help: Capture or upload an image for each eye. Both are required.
capture.file_rules: JPG or PNG only, up to 10 MB each. Capture both eyes to enable analysis.
quality.title: Image Quality Check
quality.pass_help: The images meet quality requirements and are ready for analysis.
quality.retake_help: One or both images did not pass the quality check.
iqa.retake.blur: Image is blurry — hold the camera steady
iqa.retake.blur_high: Image is blurry — hold the camera steady
iqa.retake.too_dark: Image is too dark — improve the lighting
iqa.retake.too_bright: Image is too bright — reduce the flash or lighting
iqa.retake.fov_partial: Eye is not fully visible — move the camera back
iqa.retake.low_contrast: Image contrast is too low — improve the lighting
iqa.retake.off_centre: Eye is off-centre — reposition the camera
iqa.retake.iqa_error: Image quality could not be checked — retake the photo
iqa.retake.unknown: Image needs to be retaken — capture a clear, centred photo
iqa.retake.dark: Image is too dark — increase lighting
iqa.retake.bright: Image is too bright — reduce flash
iqa.retake.fov: Eye not fully visible — move camera back
result.title: Screening Result
result.xai.guard.cam_off: Attention outside retina — needs specialist review
result.action.routine: No action needed — rescreen in 12 months
history.title: Screening History
history.no_records: No prior screenings found for this patient

error.camera_not_found: Camera not detected — check USB or webcam connection
error.upload_failed: Image upload failed — please try again
error.no_image: Please capture or upload an image first
error.no_patient_id: Please enter a Patient ID before capturing
error.no_eye: Please select which eye (Right OD / Left OS)
